EC2: Not have informed consent for the present clinical trial, or do not fully understand the meaning of informed consent.
EC3: With acute myocardial infarction [AND] with ST segment elevation in the first 12 hours from the onset of symptoms.
EC4: With any acute coronary syndrome complicated with acute pulmonary edema [OR], cardiogenic shock [OR] and / or malignant ventricular arrhythmias.
EC5: In which a cardiac catheterization is planned a priori to be performed via femoral [OR], brachial [OR] or ulnar.
EC6: Patients in whom first attempt of arterial puncture is performed by 2nd year interventional cardiology fellow or by physician in charge.
EC8: Be allergic [OR] or have contraindications to nitroglycerin [OR] or other nitrates.
EC9: Any phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitor (sildenafil [OR], tadalafil [OR], avanafil [OR], vardenafil) has been taken within 72 hours prior to the study.
